[[File:Live_Race-_Aquilaris-_Aquilaris_Classic.jpg|thumb|Aquilaris Classic]]
'''Aquilaris Classic''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aquilaris]]. The course was the fourth race in the [[Amateur Podracing Circuit]] tournament, and [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] was the track favorite.
